metrics.title: Unemployment rate
metrics.explain: Measured unemployment fell in this PLFS series. This does not measure wage adequacy or underemployment; definitions and survey coverage matter.

name: Youth employment
question: Can young people find good work?
note: Comparable youth-specific observations and definitions are still undergoing review. No numerical verdict published.

name: Real wages
question: Are earnings keeping up with prices?
note: Wage growth requires aligned sector, pay-frequency and CPI series. Source review pending.

name: Job quality
question: What kinds of jobs are being created?
note: Employment classification alone does not show job security, benefits or earnings. No consolidated assessment yet.

name: Women in workforce
question: How has women’s labour participation changed?

metrics.title: Female labour-force participation
metrics.explain: Participation rose in the PLFS series. Paid work, unpaid household enterprise participation, and quality of employment need separate evaluation.

metrics.title: Female worker population ratio
metrics.explain: A higher worker ratio does not establish adequate earnings or causal attribution to a single government.

name: Employment commitments
question: What employment promises were delivered?
note: Original wording, deadlines and independently corroborated outcomes are required. Consult the searchable promise audit for existing records.
